workspace_policy: fresh temporary local workspace for each three-run sequence
fixture_adapter: incident-guide-fixture-v1; no model or network call

timing.quantile: nearest-rank p95 = sorted sample at ceil(0.95 * n) - 1; for n=10 this is the maximum

sample_guides.Initial guide: A lease expires after 60 seconds; a second worker may retry. | Deployments restart the worker process after draining requests.
sample_guides.Deployment note changed: A lease expires after 60 seconds; a second worker may retry. | Deployments restart workers; a queued job may be reclaimed after restart.
sample_guides.Operator caution selected: A lease expires after 60 seconds; a second worker may retry. | Deployments restart workers; a queued job may be reclaimed after restart. | Lease expiry does not prove the original worker stopped; fence stale commits.

limits: Deterministic fixture tests orchestration and cache behavior, not semantic quality.
Wall times measure local fixture calls and SQLite overhead, not LLM latency or production speed.
No token, provider cost, source comprehension, learner outcome, or delivery measure is collected.
